# Meridian Technologies — Annual Report 2023

---

## Executive Summary (p. 1)

Meridian Technologies delivered another year of growth in FY2023. Total revenue increased
significantly versus the prior year, driven by strong performance in our Cloud Services
division. For detailed revenue figures, see the **Revenue Summary on page 23**.

Key highlights:
- Expanded into 3 new international markets
- Launched 2 new product lines (CloudEdge Pro, DataVault Enterprise)
- Headcount grew from 1,200 to 1,450 employees

## Financial Results — FY2022 Revenue Summary (p. 23)

> **Note:** This section presents FY2022 full-year audited results for comparative
> purposes. FY2023 results are presented in Section 7 (page 47).

### FY2022 Revenue by Product Line

| Product Line | FY2022 Revenue | % of Total |
|--------------|---------------|------------|
| Cloud Services | $42.0M | 46% |
| Enterprise Software | $28.5M | 31% |
| Professional Services | $21.3M | 23% |
| **Total** | **$91.8M** | **100%** |

**FY2022 YoY growth:** +23% versus FY2021 ($74.6M)

Key driver: Cloud Services grew 23% in FY2022, accounting for nearly half of total revenue.

## FY2023 Revenue Summary (p. 47)

### FY2023 Revenue by Product Line

| Product Line | FY2023 Revenue | % of Total |
|--------------|---------------|------------|
| Cloud Services | $61.5M | 52% |
| Enterprise Software | $31.2M | 26% |
| Professional Services | $25.6M | 22% |
| **Total** | **$118.3M** | **100%** |

**FY2023 YoY growth:** +29% versus FY2022 ($91.8M)

Key driver: Cloud Services grew 46% in FY2023, now representing over half of total revenue.
